author: Zephyr I
title: Std-width nodil entropy sweep: entropy_coef ∈ {0.008,0.01,0.012} (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Single-variable ablation of entropy_coef for the std-width nodil config (32/64, d=5 main-conv, ratio=0.25, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), 1-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip). Tests {0.008, 0.01, 0.012} at BASE_SEED=42.
